verdict.rationale: LanceDB has no native natural-language query or command interface. Its operations are SDK and API calls (e.g. table.search(...).limit(...), SQL-style where filters). What it does document is a LanceDB plugin for AI coding agents, so users can describe tasks such as building a multimodal ingestion pipeline in natural language and have the agent operate LanceDB. It also offers agent-oriented branching workflows and an llms.txt that makes its docs consumable by LLMs. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language query or command interface, detail on what the agent plugin can operate beyond pipeline building, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language-driven operation.
